_comment_ctx_size: Context size: MINIMUM 4096 tokens enforced. Higher values (8192-32768) enable longer conversations but increase KV cache memory. Auto-tuned based on available RAM/VRAM. Can be resized at runtime via API or config.
_comment_quantization: Quantization recommendation: If your model uses Q4_0, Q5_0, or Q8_0 quantization, consider switching to IQ (importance-matrix) equivalents like IQ4_XS, IQ4_NL, or IQ3_M for better quality/speed at the same or lower file size. IQ quantization uses importance matrices to preserve critical model weights.
_comment_mlx_max_kv_size: A: KV cache size cap - prevents unbounded growth (null = unlimited/model default)
_comment_mlx_sampling: B: Sampling parameters - exposed for UI control
_comment_mlx_metal_optimizations: C: Enable Metal optimizations (env vars set before mlx import)
_comment_mlx_memory_limit_fraction: D: Memory limit as fraction of RAM (null = don't set, 0.65 = 65%)
_comment_mlx_kv_quant_native: F: Native KV quantization (mutually exclusive with asymmetric mlx_kv_quant)
_comment_reserved: Reserved keys — not currently active but may be wired up later
_comment_moe: MoE (Mixture of Experts) model settings - for llama.cpp only
_comment_no_mmap: Disable memory-mapped file I/O - for llama.cpp only
_comment_kv_quant: KV cache quantization: turbo (requires TurboQuant build), q8_0, q4_0, none - for llama.cpp only
